slots.notes: Fullscreen looping muted autoplay hero background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover behind all foreground content; provides all visual depth for the page.

mechanic: A single sticky fullscreen hero where a looping background video sits behind a glassmorphic nav and vertically centered cinematic serif headline that staggers in via a fade-rise (opacity + translateY) reveal.
techDelivery: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript with shadcn/ui; fonts from Google Fonts, colors as shadcn HSL CSS variables, liquid-glass and fade-rise as hand-authored CSS.
reskinNotes: Colors are declared as bare HSL triplets for shadcn CSS variables (e.g. '201 100% 13%') rather than full hex/rgba, so the consumer must wrap them as hsl(...) or strip back to triplets. All copy is hardcoded in markup, and the H1 splits specific words ('dreams', 'through the silence.') into <em class="not-italic text-muted-foreground"> spans for two-tone color contrast, so the headline copy slot carries inline emphasis structure. H1 uses a font-metric-dependent letter-spacing (tracking-[-2.46px]) and leading-[0.95] tuned to Instrument Serif, which will need retuning for any substitute display font. The liquid-glass effect bakes white rgba gradient stops and an inset highlight into a ::before mask that assumes a light rim on a dark video, so it is tuned for dark themes.
